 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Week 9 Quentin Johnston Fantasy Start or Sit 2026 Should you start or sit Los Angeles Chargers wide receiver Quentin Johnston in Week 9 against the Houston Texans? PFN's Kyle Soppe examines Johnston's fantasy football outlook as the Chargers continue to struggle offensively. Johnston has yet to score a touchdown this season and has been held below 60 receiving yards in every game. With Justin Herbert struggling according to PFN QB Impact ratings and Los Angeles unable to establish a consistent rushing attack, Johnston's fantasy opportunities have been limited. Can Johnston rediscover his big-play ability? Will the Chargers' offense provide enough opportunities for a fantasy breakout? Soppe breaks down Johnston's recent production, offensive situation, and Week 9 matchup against Houston.
